messages:
cara: Heads-up: billing batch 2026-03-22 produced bad drafts for Acme. GPU charge missing and two drafts created. Logs attached. :grimacing:

tom: which batch id?

cara: bill-2026-03-22-batch12. snippet:

```
[2026-03-22T18:11:30Z] batch12: agg gpu_hours sum=0 tenant=acme-corp
[2026-03-22T18:11:30Z] batch12: commitment_split reserved=0.33 expected=0.75
[2026-03-22T18:11:31Z] invoice-writer: wrote draft id=draft-13111
[2026-03-22T18:11:31Z] invoice-writer: wrote draft id=draft-13112
```

diego: raw export includes gpu rows for the window. So aggregator filtered them out. Any recent infra changes?

cara: @sylvia did a partition change last night (tenant_id -> normalized_name). aggregator logged: WARN partition key mismatch: NULL normalized_name.

maya: that explains dropped rows. Why duplicates?

tom: redis shows a short read timeout at 18:11:29Z. Two workers both acquired the lease and wrote drafts.

cara: short-term remediation: void draft-13112 and patch draft-13111 to add GPU line. I'll run manual patch. Also need reconciliation job and idempotency hardening.

sylvia: rolling back partition change now and adding a test for NULL normalized_name.

diego: I'll add idempotency: write lease + marker atomically (redis lua) ETA EOD.

cara: manual patch commands (sanitized):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING" https://billing.internal/invoices/draft-13111 > /tmp/draft.json
# computed gpu charge: 168h * $30/hr = $5040
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"invoice_id":"draft-13111","ops":[{"op":"add_line","code":"GPU_HOURS","qty":168,"amount_cents":504000}]}' https://billing.internal/admin/patch
```

billing-bot: Incident created: BIL-2026-131. Severity P2. Assigned: finance oncall.

cara: patch applied at 18:27Z, draft-13112 voided. Following up after partition revert and reconciliation run.
